details.name: MOB.354_Work_Asset_Add_Remove
details.message:
`MOB.354` **Add an existing asset from the Assets tab, prove it, remove THAT link** — `Bypass Valve 0001` on the
fixture work order (`MOBILE_WORK_ADD_ASSET`, then `REMOVE_WORK_STAGE_ASSET_LINKS`).
- The picker closes on click and the remove edits the cache before a fire-and-forget mutation, so
  both ends are proved over `/graphql` (trap 6).
- 🛑 Owner-sanctioned delete (2026-09-15) of this run's link only: the premise proves `Pump 0102` is the
  only link; the guard shares a step with the gear click; the server then holds Pump's link (same
  id/status/sequence/comment), the same condition/failure ids and the rest address/x/y.
- `always`: the persisted `asset_lookup_query` is put back; a backstop removes a leftover `Bypass Valve 0001` link
  by its id (only on a run whose premise passed); the last read requires the fixture at rest.
- 🐞 Bug evidence: expanding an asset row before the Asset schema is cached crashes the page
  (`AssetLookupDetails/index.tsx:43`); the expand is gated on the rows' geolocate controls.
